title: Pumpkin Oatmeal
summary: This cozy fall breakfast pumpkin oatmeal is a breeze to whip up and makes for a seriously delicious and hearty way to kickstart your day.
steps: To a medium sauce pan, add all the ingredients and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes, until the oats are softened.
Serve warm, topped with your favorite toppings.
